Method of Attack: Installed as a file system filter driver to intercept SMB traffic and replace legitimate shared executable files with malware-infected files
Targets computers with shared folders to deliver malicious executables via SMB
Replaces up to 20 legitimate files at a time, max 800MB per file
Delivers malware-infected files instead of legitimate files during SMB file downloads
Uses Windows minifilter driver registered under the 'Null' service key in the registry
Impacted Systems: Windows computers with shared folders, especially enterprise file sharing servers
Attack Vector: SMB file sharing on infected Windows machines
Indicators of Compromise: Presence of minifilter driver registry keys under the 'Null' service key with 2 sub keys and 3 values
Malware-infected files delivered via SMB instead of legitimate shared files
